title: Giovanni Mazzinghi's cipher letter of 16 January 1478 (1479 modern), ASF MAP LXXXIX 142

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LXXXIX, doc. 142 (old c. 149)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf; the sibling MAP LXXII 170 (23 Jan 1478) has an interlinear one in the same system.

transcription.source: ASF IIIF A0000463, 1272 x 1837 (largest size served)
transcription.notes: Some sign pairs cannot be told apart at this resolution (o, 4, H, b/6).

system.summary: Letter substitution in letter-like signs with word division kept, numerals for persons and a barred p for per.
system.sibling_key: MAP LXXII 170 (lead 2308), same sign set, glossed interlinear; not yet rebuilt sign by sign
system.notes: 29 sign classes seen at 1272 px; several classes probably hold two or three signs.

prior_solution.where: none found: DECODE, Tomokiyo, Lasry, Lorenzo's Lettere II-III checked in the catalogue vetting (6 Nov 2026)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: the catalogue entry's task prompt was pasted into Claude Code; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: IIIF images of 89/142 and of the sibling 72/170; 1272 px is the largest size.
First pass of 89/142, 29 sign classes, 1055 signs.
Paired the 72/170 gloss with its cipher; only 'publichamente mostra lectere' aligned with confidence.
Homophonic annealer on it-cinquecento; collapsed onto all-i.
Same with a letter-frequency KL penalty and swap moves; Italian came out (contra di voi molto crudele, molte volte, grandissimo).
537-sign Italian passage in a random 29-sign homophonic key: 655/667 letters right.
Second transcription pass in 3x crops and word-by-word reading; merged sign classes resolved from context.

outcome.method_basis: The key came from a solver run on the ciphertext alone and was read out word by word; the one sibling gloss pair checked agrees but was not used to build it.
outcome.notes: 111 of 189 cipher words read, 30 doubtful, 48 open. Content dates it after the Pazzi conspiracy: January 1479 modern. In progress: sibling key rebuild next.

gaps.item: 48 open cipher words and about 30 doubtful ones from merged sign classes
code numerals 2, 3, 10, 12, 30, 40 and groups olop, ov+, cop, oxP
